segments.text: Better, once I figured out the little app. My granddaughter set it up.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: I won't ask you for your card number or any codes. I just need a yes or no on a couple of purchases.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Fine, what are they?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Sorry, I had to sit down. My legs aren't what they were. Go on.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Sure, take your time.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: There's a charge of nine hundred dollars at a hardware store in Buffalo this morning. Does that sound like you?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: I see.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Sure.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Hmm, nine hundred dollars? Let me think. Oh yes, that was the garden center.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Okay, I've noted that. There's also a small online charge of four dollars and ninety nine cents. Recognize that one?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: That one I don't recognize, no.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Perfect. I've cleared the alert on your card. You don't need to do anything else.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Okay. I'll do that.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: How's the garden this year?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: The tomatoes are late but the beans went crazy.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Did you get the pictures I sent?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: I did. The baby has your father's ears, poor thing.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: How's the hip doing?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Better. The therapy helps, but the stairs are still slow.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Did you watch the game last night?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: I fell asleep in the third quarter. Did they win?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: You're welcome. Have a good day, Eleanor.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Goodbye.
